implementationStatus: Documentation interfaces only. A role returns RoleResult@1 status written after valid candidate bytes exist; the orchestrator routes ordinary artifact acceptance separately. A recoverable unavailable interface is recorded by the orchestrator and Workflow Ledger as a same-state pause, never fabricated success.

loaderBootstrap.selectionRule: Read this manifest first, select matching skill IDs, then load only each selected file and the transitive files declared by requires.
loaderBootstrap.indexRole: craft/index.md is human-readable routing guidance loaded only through its craft-index manifest entry; it is not a machine bootstrap or a second selector.

triggerConditions: A human reader needs the non-normative explanation of manifest-based craft routing.
entryConditions: The role, workflow state, and task trigger are known.
exitEvidence: The reader understands that machine loading began with this manifest and followed only selected file and transitive requires fields without extending authority.

triggerConditions: The task needs cross-domain hierarchy, staging, holds, easing, focal shifts, or transition vocabulary.
entryConditions: Approved Brief and applicable Treatment context are available.
exitEvidence: A role-owned treatment, motion plan, or review cites applicable motion rationale.

triggerConditions: Any Treatment narrative arc, beat intention, audience takeaway, or emotional through-line is being planned or reviewed.
entryConditions: Approved Brief goal, single message, and audience are available.
exitEvidence: The Treatment declares an emotional arc with a per-beat audience takeaway and a single through-line, mapped to typed narrative functions.

triggerConditions: Beat durations, hold lengths, stagger, or the rhythm of reveals are being planned or reviewed.
entryConditions: The narrative arc and motion profile are available.
exitEvidence: Beat and bridge durations form a coherent felt cadence with landed payoffs and choreographed staggers.

triggerConditions: Frame composition, focal placement, negative space, or eye-lead is being planned or reviewed.
entryConditions: The beat focal hierarchy and visual system are known.
exitEvidence: Each beat has a single composed focal hero, deliberate negative space, and a directed eye path.

triggerConditions: Any Treatment is authored or any creative review is performed — the premium bar applies to all films.
entryConditions: The Brief, style pack, and visual system context are current.
exitEvidence: The plan or review is measured against the premium definition-of-done, not only the comprehension floor.

triggerConditions: The task plans or reviews a Beat boundary, persistent identity, bridge, handoff, content change, or chapter cut.
entryConditions: Continuity policy is seamless-default and adjacent Beat IDs are known.
exitEvidence: Each adjacent Beat boundary has mode-specific lawful evidence or the single documented chapter-cut exception.

triggerConditions: A real overview-to-detail, nesting, adjacency, route, or scale relationship may justify camera travel.
entryConditions: Verified spatial facts or supplied local assets support the proposed relationship.
exitEvidence: Travel names the revealed relationship, or a more truthful held/shared composition is selected.

triggerConditions: A global camera hold, travel, framing change, or eye-trace decision is being planned or reviewed.
entryConditions: Source and destination focal nodes are known for any proposed travel.
exitEvidence: Camera holds or travels have focal, eye-trace, endpoint, and semantic-relation evidence.

triggerConditions: The task needs palette, typography, shape language, spacing, texture, contrast, or motion-character guidance.
entryConditions: Brief facts, constraints, and local asset/font status are current.
exitEvidence: A role-owned plan or review identifies a coherent, accessible visual system.

triggerConditions: The task needs a concrete broadcast-grade baseline of palette, type ladder, spacing, and reusable node/effect recipes, or a reviewer flags amateur styling.
entryConditions: Brief facts, constraints, and a selected style pack are current.
exitEvidence: A role-owned plan or review applies the design-system tokens and recipes to concrete node props.

triggerConditions: Verified copy, labels, captions, headlines, or text content changes carry motion meaning.
entryConditions: Copy and font/glyph constraints are resolved.
exitEvidence: Text changes have readable settled holds and declared content transitions.

triggerConditions: A geometric shape, path, mask, or drawn relation carries semantic intent.
entryConditions: The shape/path semantic job and stable target are declared.
exitEvidence: Paths and shapes retain identity and communicate the specified relation or action.

triggerConditions: The film depicts verified quantities, charts, ranked values, or numeric comparisons.
entryConditions: Verified source values, labels, units, scope, and uncertainty are available.
exitEvidence: The plan preserves verified values, order, units, uncertainty, and legibility.

triggerConditions: The film explains a verified process, system, flow, architecture, or relationship.
entryConditions: Supported nodes, endpoints, and relations are documented.
exitEvidence: Stable nodes and bound connectors explain the verified relationship.

triggerConditions: Supplied local UI states, flows, and verified user actions are depicted.
entryConditions: Exact supplied UI evidence and verified product facts are available.
exitEvidence: Every action maps to evidence and every claimed persistent UI node retains real identity.

triggerConditions: A locally supplied licensed logo or identity asset needs an introduction, bridge, or resolve.
entryConditions: Local provenance, permission, and brand constraints are resolved.
exitEvidence: The final mark remains intact, legible, stable, and held after resolve.

triggerConditions: A subordinate atmospheric layer is justified by the Treatment.
entryConditions: The focal-content plan and visual system are known.
exitEvidence: Ambient motion supports rather than competes with focal content.

triggerConditions: Musical intent must be authored for an approved locked silent cut.
entryConditions: The approved locked silent cut and matching plan, approval, review, QC, master, and manifest bindings are present.
exitEvidence: One bound AudioBrief candidate declares exactly one payoff cue and Sound Designer returns RoleResult@1 status written; acceptance and later AUDIO_PROMPT execution belong only to the orchestrator and deterministic interfaces.

triggerConditions: The orchestrator must assess silent, audio-handoff, optional-mix, or final delivery evidence.
entryConditions: Current revision, plan, QC, review, approval, render manifest, silent master, actual AudioBrief, actual content-addressed MUSIC_PROMPT.md, and selected output bindings are available.
exitEvidence: The orchestrator identifies a valid content-addressed delivery evidence set or records a same-state deferred-interface pause without claiming success.
